sam: CI is red on my branch, pre-commit/format/type checks failing on PR 4021. low on time, can someone eyeball? :grimacing:
ci-bot: check-suite: pre-commit · failed · details: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/actions/runs/987654321 · failing hooks: pyright, eslint, black
alex: link to PR?
sam: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4021 · commit abcdef0123. pyright error in src/runtime/cache.py shown below:
```
src/runtime/cache.py:42:8 - error: Type 'None' is not callable (reportGeneralTypeIssues)
  def get(cls) -> Callable[[], bytes | None]:
                 ~~~~~~~~
Found 1 error in 1 file.
```
maya: hmm looks like a signature change upstream maybe. black/eslint failures are just autofixable. pyright will block the gate though.
jordan: can you run `pre-commit run --all-files` locally to show diffs? if it's small we can just push the fixes.
sam: ran locally, eslint + black fixed with auto-apply. pyright still errors.
priya: can you paste the function around that line? might be a typing annotation that needs Optional[Callable[...]]
sam: here:
```python
class KVCache:
    @classmethod
    def get(cls) -> Callable[[], bytes | None]:
        # used to be returning a callable or None in some paths
        return cls._make_getter()
```
alex: I think the return type should be Optional[Callable[[], Optional[bytes]]]. Pyright recently started enforcing union precedence with |. Changing to `Callable[[], bytes] | None` vs `Optional[Callable[[], Optional[bytes]]]` matters.
maya: also note we recently bumped pyright to 1.2.0 in main which tightened checks — that could explain why this started failing now.
jordan: if this only started after the pyright bump on main, bisecting main would confirm. but since it's a PR, simplest is adjust typing in that function.
priya: I can open a tiny fix PR to change signature and add a comment. sam, do you want me to push to your branch or make a follow-up?
sam: please push to my branch if you can. I'm tied up in customer calls. thanks! :pray:
ci-bot: re-run requested: workflow rerun by priya · queued
ci-bot: rerun complete: pre-commit · failed (pyright)
alex: if rerun still fails, run `git checkout main && git pull && git merge --no-ff <your-branch>` locally to reproduce with main's pyright version, or just run `npx -y pyright src/runtime/cache.py` to see the same error.
priya: pushed fix to sam/4021-typing-fix (small signature tweak + test). also ran `pyright` locally against main+branch — clean. opened PR comment.
sam: thanks priya! pinging reviewers: @alex @maya for quick look (won't change behavior).
alex: quick review done, looks good. merging after green.
ci-bot: checks passed on merge commit 1234fedc · pre-commit · success
jordan: sweet. note for postmortem: update the dev docs about pyright bump and the recommended pattern for optional callables.
maya: adding a short note to the dev-checklist doc.
sam: great, closing this thread. :tada:
